prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that parses the Accept header per RFC 7231 media-range rules: it splits/trims each entry, excludes entries with q=0, and matches type/subtype including wildcards. #2046 instead uses a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring check, which doesn't honor q=0 exclusion or wildcard media ranges (e.g. `*/*`, `application/*`), so it handles a narrower set of valid Accept header forms for the same underlying bug.

clusters.pick_reason: #2214 applies the regex strip but does not update shouldAttemptFallback, which still checks pathname === '/'. Since the new regex strip turns a root pathname of '/' into '', that root short-circuit silently stops matching, so root-like discovery paths would incorrectly retry fallback discovery after #2214 alone. #2215 introduces the same regex-based strip via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper and also updates shouldAttemptFallback to check pathname === '', keeping the root-path short-circuit correct after normalization. #2215 is a strict superset fix; #2214 alone leaves a regression.
